items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: many times people worked for me, like Mesro

ctx.x: In other words, you hadn't come to your narrow definition of jazz yet.
That's right. And, for example, many times people worked for me, like Mesro, and Pee Wee Russell, and Miff Mole, and Joe Sullivan.
This was all jazz to you?
